data.title: Abbisko Presents Preclinical Findings for Selective CDK4 Inhibitor
data.description:
Abbisko Cayman Limited ( (HK:2256) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Abbisko Therapeutics presented at 2026 ENA a study selected for the Late-Breaking Abstracts program, detailing preclinical findings for ABSK192 in HR+/HER2- breast cancer models. The compound showed potent CDK4 inhibition with more than 70-fold selectivity over CDK6, antiproliferative activity regardless of PIK3CA mutation status, G1 arrest and robust single-agent antitumor activity in vivo.

Combination experiments found synergistic activity with endocrine, PI3K and CDK2 inhibitors in vitro; combinations with fulvestrant, imlunestrant or GDC-0077 produced enhanced antitumor efficacy and tumor-volume regression in vivo. Abbisko said the findings support ABSK192’s development potential as a selective CDK4 inhibitor and provide a preclinical rationale for single-agent and combination regimens.

data.title: HUTCHMED Presents Preclinical HMPL-A830 Data at Cancer Research Conference
data.description:
An update from HUTCHMED (China) ( (HK:0013) ) is now available.

HUTCHMED develops oncology drug candidates, including antibody-targeted therapy conjugates (ATTCs) that pair monoclonal antibodies with small-molecule inhibitor payloads for solid tumors. Its ATTC approach combines targeted therapies with dual mechanisms of action.

The release reports preclinical HMPL-A830 data presented at the EORTC-NCI-AACR conference in Barcelona on November 18–20, 2026. The EGFR-directed ATTC showed activity across diverse KRAS alterations in laboratory and mouse studies, while a global Phase I trial is evaluating the candidate; a GSK subsidiary received rights outside Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan under a September 2026 agreement.

data.title: HBM Holdings Announces NMPA Acceptance of LET003 IND Application
data.description:
HBM Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:2142) ) has issued an announcement.

HBM Holdings develops monoclonal antibody drug candidates, including LET003 for overweight or obesity, using its Hu-mAtrIx™ AI platform.

China’s NMPA accepted the IND application for LET003, the company’s first AI-enabled drug candidate and a dual ACVR2A/ACVR2B blocker. data.title: Listing Committee Upholds Decision to Suspend Goldstone Capital Shares
data.description:
Youth Champ Financial Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:1160) ) just unveiled an announcement.

The Listing Committee upheld the Stock Exchange’s decision to suspend trading in Goldstone Capital Group’s shares after finding that the company had not maintained sufficient operations and assets of sufficient value to support its operations under Rule 13.24. The decision followed a 10 November 2026 hearing and was communicated to the company on 18 November 2026.

During the five-year review period, the company’s financial assets ranged from nil to HK$6.6 million at year-end and consisted mainly of short-term U.S. treasury bills and debt securities, with no evidence of active investment activities or portfolio management. The Listing Committee also found that the company lacked the established management and operational infrastructure necessary for a substantive investment operation.
